gate_changes_reviewed.change: formal novelty and reduction pressure tightened after C19-R2, PD01/H5 interpretation, NI01 privilege audit, and causal-credit literature
world/task/regime label treated as explicit comparator privilege
positive candidate-signal requirement separated from mechanistic reduction interpretation
new live scheduler doctrine splits DISCOVERY, ARCHITECTURE_STUDY, PRE_FORMAL, FORMAL and adds bounded candidate pool

false_positive_risks: promoting Discovery, Architecture Study, or Pre-formal observations into formal claims without a fresh prospective object
treating stronger-privilege replay/global-critic/actual-cause ceilings as equal-privilege mechanistic reductions
letting repeated exploratory cycles become outcome-responsive rescue tuning
retroactively importing newly discovered literature comparators into already-consumed evidence interpretations
false_negative_risks: binary formal-or-stop allocation suppressing architecture/system characterization and hypothesis generation
using new-computational-principle novelty as the threshold for architecture, engineering, or testbed research-worthiness
treating prior H1-H9 family exploration as blanket observable-level exhaustion
interpreting independent-motivation rules as forbidding prospectively defined literature-seeded fresh questions

duplicate_guards.recommendation: Operationally consolidate one-way integrity checks into a single checklist/state machine where practical, while preserving all protected failure modes.

moving_goalpost_assessment.basis: Important tightenings have remained prospective and consumed evidence has stayed immutable. Risk would increase if later literature ceilings were retroactively treated as preregistered matched comparators.

external_calibration.literature: Counterfactual responsibility/credit is ordinary territory; COMA/C3/concurrent responsibility strengthen prior-art pressure but often with stronger privilege.
external_calibration.independent_audit: NI01 confirms that task/world/regime label privilege must be explicit; canonical FAIL remains valid but equal-privilege mechanistic reduction is weakened.
external_calibration.use_rule: External findings calibrate future novelty/baselines prospectively and do not rewrite consumed evidence.

opportunity_cost_assessment: Further formal tightening currently has lower expected information gain than productive bounded Discovery/Architecture/Pre-formal work. Keep FORMAL strict while restoring lower-layer throughput.
prospective_recommendations: Keep the four-layer research funnel and treat FORMAL HOLD separately from programme-wide inactivity.
Require claim-type labeling for every candidate.
Record equal-privilege reductions separately from stronger-privilege functional ceilings.
Verify next durable Analyst/MAIN/SUB cycles actually create and consume a bounded candidate pool rather than reproduce universal no-op.
If no-op persists, require observable-level exhaustion justification rather than family-level 'already explored' reasoning.
Preserve the default three-cycle exploration budget with explicit reasoned exceptions.
Allow prospectively defined literature-seeded fresh Discovery while continuing to ban post-outcome rescue of consumed lines.
Never alter consumed/frozen evidence because of methodology changes.
questions_for_control_brain: Will the next Control handoff explicitly distinguish FORMAL HOLD from lower-layer research throughput and measure candidate-pool health?
Will stronger-privilege COMA/C3/global responsibility solvers be recorded as ceilings rather than automatic mechanistic reject gates unless privilege is matched?
Will architecture/system questions remain researchable after a new-principle novelty claim is reduced?
questions_for_evidence_analyst: Will the next handoff populate a candidate_pool across Discovery/Architecture/Pre-formal even if FORMAL remains empty?
If SUB remains no-op, can the justification be stated at the observable/question level rather than by broad H1-H9 family coverage?
Can fresh literature-seeded questions be admitted to Discovery when they are prospectively defined and not rescues of consumed outcomes?
